description: Consolidated new feature E2E issue for zaq-h2i.3; authoring blocked by explicit final human UX/UI approval zaq-h2i.3.4 after shared Main/Advanced tabs zaq-h2i.3.6. Reuse existing channel/system_config/streamed_updates browser fixtures and suites where cohesive. Planned final journeys: generic and SMTP editors start on Main; applicable Advanced sections group streamed updates, File delivery and SMTP transport controls; Advanced is absent only when no section applies. Repeated pointer/keyboard switches retain all unsaved values, credentials and false policies and cause no persistence/runtime updates. One existing whole-form Save includes inactive controls and persists exact decimal MB/count/policy values to the selected connection; reload retains them and unrelated settings. Cover Main-only, Advanced-only and simultaneous errors: mark affected tabs, select Main first if both invalid, retain every draft and leave persisted configuration unchanged. Cover fixed/read-only limits, required/malformed/over-ceiling errors, optional blank overrides, unavailable metadata never meaning unlimited, and capability-driven visibility including unsupported connections. Include People-style DesignSystem.Toggle native Tab/Shift-Tab focus, Enter/Space activation, aria-pressed selection and labelled section visibility. Preserve the reviewed empty-required-limit and omitted-file-settings persistence fixes. No sending, attachment acquisition or delivery planning. Existing feature tests may receive minimal selector/navigation repairs preserving assertions and intent; new feature journeys wait for final UX approval. Smaller tests and manual browser inspection continue beforehand. After approval implement consolidated browser coverage and record validation/environment failures. Reuse existing public UI and Engine save operations; no new business Action or endpoint. Do not run mix precommit or commit/push/publish without authorization.
